prompt: Build a pay-per-call joke API that charges 0.005 ALGO per request using x402

spec.name: JokePayPerCall
spec.description: A pay-per-call joke API that charges ALGO per request using x402 protocol on Algorand

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initialize joke service with price config

methods.name: record_payment
methods.description: Verify and record payment from atomic group transaction (trustless — reads ALGO PaymentTxn from gtxn)

ui_requirements: Service dashboard showing total jokes served and earnings
Demo 'Get Joke' button that triggers the x402 ALGO payment flow
Price display (0.005 ALGO) and payment status
business_logic: Payment verified on-chain via atomic group (gtxn) reading PaymentTxn(0)
Contract verifies payment receiver is the contract address and amount meets price
Price is set at creation (5000 microALGO for 0.005 ALGO)

methods.name: createApplication
methods.desc:
createApplication
Lifecycle method called on contract creation.
Initializes the service owner and default pricing.

methods.name: record_payment
methods.desc:
record_payment
Trustless on-chain verification for x402 payments.
Expects an atomic group where:
gtxn[0]: PaymentTxn (ALGO from user to contract)
gtxn[1]: AppCall (this method)

methods.name: set_price
methods.desc:
set_price
Allows the owner to update the microALGO cost per joke.

methods.name: get_stats
methods.desc:
get_stats
Returns the total number of jokes served.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.desc:
withdraw
Allows the owner to claim accumulated ALGO from the contract.
